items.title: Reunión Abierta de La Viña
items.summary: Una reunión abierta virtual de AA en español. Cada semana la guía un coordinador, con dos oradores que son miembros de AA; entre quienes participan hay autores de historias de La Viña y servidores de confianza. Las reuniones se graban: puedes escucharlas en el podcast de La Viña, en tus plataformas de podcast favoritas o en YouTube. ¡Sigamos extendiendo juntos esta poderosa cuerda salvavidas!

extra.source_note: Official La Viña flyers shared with the committee: November 2026's, and the newest one, without a month, every Thursday in the four U.S. time zones (Drive flyers/, 2026-11-12)

summary.en: A virtual open AA meeting in Spanish. Each week a chairperson leads it, with two speakers who are AA members; among those taking part are La Viña story authors and trusted servants. Every meeting is recorded, so you can listen to it later on La Viña's podcast, on your favorite podcast platforms or on YouTube. Let's keep extending this powerful lifeline together!

items.title: Grapevine Weekly Open AA Meeting
items.summary: Each week AA Grapevine holds an open virtual AA meeting with a host and two speakers. We record the meeting to create this podcast.

extra.sentence: To join the meeting live on Wednesdays at Noon Eastern, use Zoom code 871 2036 8287 with password 238047
